questions.questionText:
We ask this to help us understand any adjustments or modifications that may support your participation. While we may not be able to accommodate every individual need, having this information allows us to explore reasonable modifications where appropriate and communicate clearly about what we can offer. 

If we’re not able to provide a suitable modification, alternative option, or service, we’ll be upfront about why and let you know about other appropriate options available within the GV area. 

You’re always welcome to click 'Continue' if you’d rather not share details.
